name: Koma Enji
source:
Koma Enji is a ghoul and a waiter at Anteiku. He is also an expert coffee brewer. In his youth, he was known as the Devil Ape (魔猿, Maen) and led the Apes ghoul gang. he escapes from Cochlea and hunts for the real culprit. 

[From [url=http://tokyoghoul.wikia.com/wiki/Enji_Koma]Tokyo Ghoul Wikia[/url]]
